description: This file defines a client class for interacting with the AWS Resource Groups service, including method signatures for various operations such as creating, deleting, and querying resource groups.

classes.name: ResourceGroupsClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with the AWS Resource Groups service.

methods.name: getAccountSettings
methods.description: Retrieves account settings related to resource groups.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Fetches details of a specific resource group.

methods.name: getGroupConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a resource group.

methods.name: getGroupQuery
methods.description: Gets the query used to define a resource group.

methods.name: getTagSyncTask
methods.description: Retrieves a specific tag sync task.

methods.name: listGroupingStatuses
methods.description: Lists the statuses of resource groupings.

methods.name: putGroupConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a resource group.

methods.name: searchResources
methods.description: Searches for resources based on query.

methods.name: startTagSyncTask
methods.description: Starts a new tag sync task.

methods.name: updateAccountSettings
methods.description: Updates account settings related to resource groups.

methods.name: updateGroupQuery
methods.description: Updates the query used to define a resource group.
